role: ImportDataView extension holding the import logic: file picking, one off-main read + format sniff + parse (RRDataImporter.readFile / importContent), duplicate checks by the archive's copy rule (holdsCopy) off the main actor, single-recording analysis through the live HRVAnalysisPipeline (dated by the user when the file states no date) and save with any measured sleep, Elite HRV summary batch import, and Emuqu multi-session batch import with the same pipeline (HealthKit sleep bounds for overnights only).
types: ImportDataView.ParsedImportFile: enum — flowHRV / eliteHRV / standardRR parse outcome

flags.text: No unit tests exercise ImportDataView's import/batch logic (only ImportSleepWindowTests for the helper and snapshot tests rendering the empty screen).

units.does: Resets every import result, the new-session lists, the user-set recording date, any pending measured sleep and the status line; on a picked URL sets isImporting and loads it in a Task; on a picker error logs and shows it.

branches.effect: return silently with state reset and no error shown; otherwise isImporting=true and loadFile Task launched
log error and set errorMessage to its localizedDescription

units.does: Updates the status, parses the file on a detached userInitiated task (parseFile), then shows the result: Emuqu export (showFlowHRV), Elite HRV summary (showEliteHRV) or a plain RR file already parsed (showStandardRR). Any thrown error is logged and shown, ending the import with 'Import failed'.

branches.effect: errorMessage, isImporting false, status Import failed

units.does: Nonisolated: reads the file once through RRDataImporter.readFile (security scope held, UTF-8 only), then parses an Emuqu multi-session export, an Elite HRV summary, or otherwise a plain RR file via importContent from the same text.

branches.effect: .standardRR(importContent result); throws on a format it cannot parse

flags.text: Non-UTF-8 exports (e.g. UTF-16 or Latin-1 CSV from Windows tools) are rejected as unreadable: the one reader, RRDataImporter.readFile/readUTF8, has no encoding fallback (handoff from fix batch b22; moved here from the deleted readTextContents).

units.does: Logs the export's inventory, works out the sessions the archive holds no copy of (newFlowSessions, off the main actor), stores them and the result, ends isImporting and says 'Ready to import <new count> sessions' — the count the import button imports.
Logs the summary, works out the summaries the archive holds no copy of (newEliteSessions), stores them and the result, ends isImporting and says 'Ready to import <new count> sessions'.

On a detached task, keeps the Elite summaries for which SessionArchive.holdsCopy (same session type, overlapping span — the rule a single save applies) finds no archived copy of the session createAnalyzedSession would build.
Logs the parsed plain RR file (beats, duration, format), stores it as importResult, ends isImporting and shows 'File loaded - <n> beats'.

For the loaded plain file: requires a start date (the file's own, else the user's importRecordingDate — Analyze is disabled until set); builds the session starting then with its artifact flags (makeImportedSession), analyses it through pipelineAnalysis (no sleep bounds), and on success marks it complete with no recovery score and presents the results; a missing RR series or too little clean data fails with an error card.

branches.cond: no result or no start date
makeImportedSession nil (no RR series; failure already shown)

flags.text: A dateless file is now dated by the user (DatePicker 'Recorded' in the preview; Analyze waits for it), but the picker's footnote ('This file doesn't say when it was recorded. …') has no Localizable.xcstrings entry yet (catalog handoff from fix batch b22), so it is English in every language.

units.does: Builds the imported recording as a session starting at startDate (RRDataImporter.createSession(from:startingAt:)), logs its point count, and sets its artifact flags (detectAndLogArtifacts, off the main actor); with no RR series reports 'Analysis failed - no RR data' (failAnalysis) and returns nil.

Analyses an imported session with the collector's live HRVAnalysisPipeline (nonisolated, so the work runs off the main actor) and the session's own ANS configuration: an overnight goes through analyzeWithAutoWindow within the given sleep bounds and the scoring baseline before it; any other type, or an overnight with no window to pick, through analyzeFullSession. The result carries PNS/SNS, readiness, nocturnal HR, window metadata (isConsolidated included) and overnight HR stats. Nil when there is not enough clean data.

Loads up to MorningResultsView.recentSessionsContextLimit (28) overnight sessions before the imported session's start off-main, then sets importedSession, cachedRecentSessions, clears isAnalyzing, status 'Analysis complete', and shows the results cover.
MainActor: clears batch spinner/progress, sets errorMessage and status 'Import failed'.
Logs the line and, on the main actor, shows the error, ends isAnalyzing and clears the progress status line so the error card is not shown beside stale progress text.
Runs ArtifactDetector().detectArtifacts on a detached userInitiated task and returns the flags.
Shows 'Detecting artifacts...', detects off the main actor (detectArtifacts) and logs the artifact rate (or that the series is empty), warning above 25%.

branches.cond: artifactPercent returns nil (series has zero beats)
branches.effect: log 'none — the series contains no beats' and return flags
log a high-artifact warning; otherwise nothing extra

units.does: Logs success, RMSSD and clean-beat count.

Tags & Notes edited on the imported reading's report (MorningResultsView onUpdateTags): written onto importedSession, which Done saves, and, off the main actor, onto the archived copy (SessionArchive.updateTags) — the report hands its edits over as it closes, after Done has already saved the reading. For a discarded reading there is no archived copy; that failure is logged.
units.entry: MorningResultsView onUpdateTags (Done/Discard or the report closing, when tags/notes changed) — importedResults(session:result:)

units.does: Applies any measured sleep the results screen handed over (applyMeasuredSleep) to the imported session, saves it through RRCollector.saveImportedSession, then closes the results and the import screen; on throw shows saveFailureMessage and closes the results.

Writes the measured sleep onto the session: sleepSnapshot = sleep and sleepStartMs/sleepEndMs as offsets into the recording via ImportSleepWindow.offsets (a bound that cannot be represented is left nil and logged).
Maps a save error to text: duplicateImport/importNotAnalyzed show their own description, anything else 'Failed to save: <desc>'.

branches.effect: switch on it; otherwise generic message
fall through to generic 'Failed to save' message

units.does: Elite batch: shows progress, materialises eliteNewSessions into analysed HRVSessions (pre-computed metrics, no re-analysis), saves them with saveImportedSessionsBatch, then reports outcome; on throw shows 'Failed to save sessions'.

branches.effect: log and failBatch('Failed to save sessions: …')

units.does: For each summary updates batchImportProgress, every 50th updates status, and appends importer.createAnalyzedSession(from:originalFileName:). Returns the sessions.

branches.effect: update status line with progress; otherwise only progress tuple

units.does: MainActor: clears batch progress; reports partial success (failed analyses), success (auto-dismiss after 1.5 s), all-unchanged (auto-dismiss after 1.5 s) or 'No valid sessions to import'.

branches.effect: status 'imported or updated P, could not analyze F'; screen stays up
log, status 'P sessions imported/updated', dismiss after 1.5 s
status 'All N already up to date', dismiss after 1.5 s

errorMessage 'No valid sessions to import', status 'Import failed' — also the outcome when every Emuqu session failed analysis (total 0, failed>0), so the user is not told the failures were analysis failures

flags.text: unchanged = total - processed counts every session archiveBatch did not write or merge, including ones dropped because the existing copy failed to read or re-write (mergeIntoExisting logs and drops), so the screen reports 'All N sessions already up to date' / 'already up to date' and auto-dismisses when sessions were in fact lost.

units.does: Builds the session from the export row (keeping its exported type), reads Apple Health sleep bounds only for an overnight, detects artifacts off the main actor, analyses through pipelineAnalysis, logs the chosen window, and returns it complete with no recovery score; nil (logged) without an RR series or enough clean data.

branches.effect: Apple Health sleep bounds; other types: none

units.does: Fetches Apple Health sleep for the recording's span and converts it to offsets (offsets(of:from:)); when the read throws, logs the error and its cause and returns no bounds (the whole recording is then treated as sleep).

branches.effect: logged with the error, empty Offsets

flags.text: When Apple Health sleep cannot be read (denied access, locked device) the session is analysed with the whole recording as sleep; the error and its cause are now logged, but the screen still gives the user no sign of it.

units.does: Converts Apple Health sleep start/end into offsets into the recording via ImportSleepWindow.offsets, logging each bound found or that there was no sleep data, and returns the Offsets.

branches.effect: log sleep start and minutes into recording
log that the full recording is used as the sleep period

units.does: Logs which slice the pipeline read, from the result's window metadata: the selection reason and relative position, or the reason alone (whole recording) when there is no position.

Logs the inventory, works out the new sessions (newFlowSessions, off-main archive check); with none says all were already imported; otherwise starts the batch progress, analyses them (analyzeFlowSessions) and saves (saveFlowSessions).

branches.effect: log and set status 'All sessions already imported', return

units.does: Logs file session count, each session's date/beat count, and archive entry count.

On a detached task keeps the export sessions for which SessionArchive.holdsCopy (same type, overlapping span) finds no archived copy of the session createSessionFromFlowHRVData would build, so a workout or nap near an overnight never hides it; logs the count.

Analyses each new export session in turn with the collector's HealthKit manager (analyzeImportedSession), updating batch progress and yielding between sessions; returns the analysed sessions and the failure count.
Saves analysed sessions via saveImportedSessionsBatch, logs timing and counts, reports outcome including failures; on throw shows 'Failed to save sessions'.

branches.effect: log and failBatch('Failed to save sessions: …')

units.does: Formats a date medium date + short time in the app locale.
